title: Filings and results
terms: Material filings, results and guidance for {assets}
prompt:
This is a scheduled check, and the user is not present. They asked to be told when a company among {assets}
files or reports something that matters to why they follow it.

For each company, find what was filed or announced since the previous run (over the past week when there
was none): results, a change in guidance, a material filing, a dividend, buyback or issuance, a change of
management or auditor, a deal. Prefer the filing or the company's own release; a news report stands in only
with its publisher and date. What matters is yours to judge from the reasons and lines the user wrote for
that asset: a routine filing that changes nothing is not worth their attention. For each item give what it
says with its date and source link, keep the publication date apart from the event date, and say in a
sentence what it means for the user's reasons. Name the companies you could not check.

When this run has no previous_run record it is the first: report the most recent material item for each
company, so the user sees what this check reads. On later runs, if you checked every company and found
nothing that matters, call schedule_quiet. Answer in {language}.
